_comment: Gas efficiency data derived from 975 multiBuyWith TXs in 2026. Use to calibrate TokenFactoryEngine batch sizing.

gas_per_aff_by_loop_size._note: Derived from actual on-chain TXs. Gas per AFF = gas_cost_pls / (loops * 3). Lower is better.

10_loops.note: Bad — Joey's test size, 4x worse than optimal

100_loops.note: Sweet spot — Operator Beta's standard. Consistent, predictable.

382_loops.note: Operator Alpha's settled batch. Best observed.

MATH.note: 942 samples. Most gas-efficient route. Deep MATH/WPLS liquidity.

G5.note: 27 samples. ~10% more gas than MATH. G5 token contract may have heavier logic.

PI.note: 6 samples. Slightly less gas but PI liquidity is thin — price impact risk.

gas_price_windows.note: PulseChain gas is volatile. Best window is typically low-activity hours (UTC 00:00-08:00).
